A message from my heart

To my forever person

Meri Jalebia, I’m yours, Rasuglle! 🥹❤️

Yaad hai jab I met you? Starting mein 24×7 I aur U ek dusre se baatein karte the. Us time koi itna padhai ka tension bhi nahi hota tha, baby. 🥺

Meri jaan, us time bhi I U se pyaar karta tha, aur abhi bhi karta hoon. ❤️

Meri jaan, I ka pyaar U ke liye kabhi kam nahi hoga ji. Hamesha meri jaan, infinite times badhega hi ji. 💗

Meri jaan, I love U, only U. I LOVE U SOOO SOOO MUCHHH, mela bachhaaaa! 🥹💞

Abhi I U ke 3 years ho gaye. I U kabhi ek dusre se koi ladai nahi kiye, koi bhi galat cheez nahi ji. Hamesha aise hi saath aur ek dusre ka khayal rakhte hue rahenge ji. 🤞

And aaj phir bol raha hoon: U are more, more special than my own family. ❤️

I love you, meri jaan. Forever and always. ♡
